snippet.title: A Passing in the Night -- Concept Video
snippet.description:
This is an early concept video for our 3D adventure game, A Passing in the Night (currently under development).

A Passing in the Nightという3Dアドベンチャーゲーム（現在開発中）の早期コンセプトビデオです。

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3427370/
Website: http://dotiris.cloud/pitn


CREDITS
VA: Sonia Hasegawa, Tiffanie Lovett
Translation: Son Seunghee (Korean)

Unreal Engine 5
